caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on an otherwise blank, beige background. The object appears to be a dark, metallic, trapezoidal vessel with four distinct sides tapering inward toward a circular opening at the top. The vessel has a handle attached to one of its sides, curving outward and then back in near the opening. Subtle white highlights are visible along the edges of the object, suggesting reflected light. A small, neat word “white” is written in lowercase near the base of the vessel but separated from it by a small gap, nearly centered under the object. The drawing is executed with soft shadows and shading, giving the vessel a three-dimensional appearance, while the rest of the page remains plain and unadorned.
title: Sick Lamp
